fpsUnlock.step1: Locate your browser shortcut (Chrome/Edge/Brave): right-click the shortcut you use to play (Desktop or Taskbar).
fpsUnlock.step3: Modify the 'Target' field: add the flags at the very end of the path, after a space:
fpsUnlock.step4: Click 'Apply' → 'OK', then launch the game using this modified shortcut.

fpsUnlock.warning: Warning: removing VSync may cause screen tearing. Your actual FPS will depend on your GPU/CPU. Use this only if you understand the trade-off between latency and visual tearing.

privacy.deleteAccountInstructions: Account deletion: open the extension → Privacy section → "Delete my account" button. 30-day delayed deletion, cancellable.

privacy.hmacSigning: Submitted scores are HMAC-signed client-side (key rotated regularly, RPC rotate_my_hmac_secret) then verified server-side — prevents tampering.
privacy.inAppNotice: an in-app notice for non-blocking changes.
privacy.jwtStorage: Supabase session tokens (JWT) are stored via chrome.storage.local (isolated by extension, inaccessible to web pages).
privacy.localStorage: localStorage — credit balance cache, GDPR consent flag, cosmetics cache for quick display.
privacy.minorsStatement: The service is not intended for children under 13 years (COPPA limit / 15 years in France under LIL). We do not request age information; if an account belonging to a minor under the legal age is reported, the account will be deleted immediately and associated data erased.
privacy.noCookies: No third-party tracking cookies are set by the extension. The only cookies that may appear come from the Google OAuth flow (during authentication, on the accounts.google.com domain), subject to Google's policy.
privacy.noEval: No use of eval() or dynamic code evaluation.
privacy.noPasswordStorage: No user password is ever stored — authentication goes through Google OAuth (PKCE).
privacy.noRemoteCode: The extension loads no remote code (compliant with Chrome Web Store MV3 rules). All features are included in the signed package you install.
privacy.otherRightsInstructions: Rectification, access, objection, restriction: write to privacy@webtvmedia.net from the email associated with your account.
privacy.regulatoryComplaint: Right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority. If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL (National Commission for Computing and Freedoms) — French GDPR supervisory authority — or with the supervisory authority of your country of residence in the EU.
privacy.responseDeadline: Response deadline: 1 month maximum from receipt of your request (Art. 12 §3), extendable by 2 months for complex requests (you will be notified).
privacy.rls: Supabase tables are protected by Row Level Security (RLS) — each user accesses only their own data.
privacy.storageOnlyBrowser: The extension uses the following storage mechanisms only in your browser:
privacy.substantialChanges: Any material change (new purpose, new recipient, change of legal basis) will result in:
privacy.tlsEncryption: All communications with the backend are encrypted with TLS 1.2+.
privacy.versionHistory: Version history is available upon request to privacy@webtvmedia.net.
privacy.versionUpdate: an update to the version and date at the top of this page;

whatsNew.21_11_0.imp1: Discord integration fully removed: account linking, community buttons and Discord references are gone. The extension is now 100% Discord-free.
whatsNew.21_11_1.feat1: Join the Volt community on Discord: news, help, bug reports and suggestions — one click with the button below.
whatsNew.21_11_1.imp1: Following the v21.11.0 cleanup: Discord account linking (OAuth) stays fully removed — Volt simply invites you to the community server via the button below.
whatsNew.21_12_0.feat1: WEEKLY — NOCOIN CHALLENGE is live: every week, the #1 of the Weekly Volt Extension leaderboard wins 5$. Best time takes it all.
whatsNew.21_12_0.feat2: Full changelog is now built into the extension: "View full changelog" opens a complete, always-available history page.
whatsNew.21_12_0.fix1: "View full changelog" no longer shows a 404 — it now opens the in-extension changelog page instead of a private GitHub URL.
whatsNew.21_12_0.fix2: The "Close" button of this modal is fixed — it previously did nothing (only the ✕ in the corner worked).
whatsNew.21_12_0.imp1: New community home: the Discord invite is now discord.gg/tagbot — news, help, bug reports and suggestions.
whatsNew.21_12_1.fix1: The guided tour no longer overlaps this modal — it waits until you've closed the update notes.
whatsNew.21_12_1.fix2: Slimmed-down notes: everything fits the popup again, and the WEEKLY challenge is now a punchy gold headline.
whatsNew.21_12_1.fix3: Onboarding: the "pin Volt" step is gone — the welcome flow goes straight back to the popup after consent.
whatsNew.21_12_1.imp1: WEEKLY — NOCOIN CHALLENGE: every week, the #1 of the Weekly leaderboard wins 5$ — best time takes it all.
whatsNew.21_12_2.fix1: The WEEKLY — NOCOIN CHALLENGE reward is now displayed as 5$ everywhere — matching the official announcement on Discord.
whatsNew.21_12_3.feat1: Premium shop: the ELITE grade 💎 is now on sale — €5/month via PayPal. It is the only purchasable grade.
